title: PeerInfoView
description: Per-peer detail from libp2p Swarm state. Source of truth: libp2p identify protocol + per-peer runtime tracking (Operational, Category C). All ephemeral.

multiaddrs.description: Known multiaddrs for this peer (from identify)

protocols.description: Protocols supported by this peer (from identify)

agentVersion.description: Agent version string from identify protocol

rttMs.description: Round-trip time in milliseconds. Tier 3 — null until follow-up sprint implements RTT ring buffer

lastSeenMs.description: Unix epoch millis of last activity. Tier 3 — null until follow-up sprint implements lastSeen tracking

remoteNatStatus.description: Remote peer's NAT status. Tier 3 — null until follow-up sprint implements dial-back results

bandwidthIn.description: Bytes received from this peer since connection. Tier 3 — null until follow-up sprint implements BandwidthSinks

bandwidthOut.description: Bytes sent to this peer since connection. Tier 3 — null until follow-up sprint implements BandwidthSinks
